events.MYCELIAL_BANK.title: 菌根借贷所
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.description:
两只蘑菇堵住了去路。瘦的捧着账本，胖的抱着一罐[red]红色种子[/red]。一根粗根将它们连在一起。

[green]“生命放在身上，容易丢。”[/green]瘦蘑菇翻开账本。

胖蘑菇把罐子藏到身后。它看起来很擅长保管。
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.options.SHOR: 失去[red]{HpLoss}[/red]生命。接下来[blue]{Payments}[/blue]场战斗结束时各回复[green]{Heal}[/green]生命。
需要多于[red]{HpLoss}[/red]生命，且尚未存款。
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.options.LONG: 失去[red]{MaxHpCost}[/red]最大生命。击败本章Boss后获得[green]{MaxHpReturn}[/green]最大生命。
需要多于[red]{MaxHpCost}[/red]最大生命，且尚未存款。
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.SHORT.description:
细根轻轻缠住你的手腕。你感到一阵疲倦，罐子里多了几颗[red]红色种子[/red]。

瘦蘑菇在一片叶子上盖了章。

[green]“分三次送到。根会找到你的。”[/green]
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.LONG.description:
一截粗根从你掌心抽走了什么。胖蘑菇的菌盖又撑大了一圈。

[green]“大门后结清。连本带利。”[/green]

瘦蘑菇把存单递给你，顺手拍掉同伴伸向罐口的手。
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.GIFT.description:
胖蘑菇往你手里塞了一小把[gold]金币[/gold]。

[green]“见面礼！”[/green]

瘦蘑菇划掉账本上的一行，狠狠看了它一眼。
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.DEATH.description:
你眼前一黑。

瘦蘑菇停下笔。胖蘑菇把罐子抱得更紧了。

events.MYCELIAL_BANK.title: Mycelial Bank
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.description:
Two mushrooms block the path. The thin one holds a ledger; the stout one hugs a jar of [red]red seeds[/red]. A thick root joins them.

[green]“Life is easily lost if you carry it around.”[/green] The thin one opens the book.

The stout one hides the jar behind its back. It looks good at keeping things.
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.options.SHOR: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP after each of the next [blue]{Payments}[/blue] combats.
Requires more than [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP and no previous deposit.
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.options.LONG: Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP. Gain [green]{MaxHpReturn}[/green] Max HP after defeating this Act's Boss.
Requires more than [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and no previous deposit.
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.SHORT.description:
Fine roots curl around your wrist. You feel tired. A few more [red]seeds[/red] appear in the jar.

The thin mushroom stamps a leaf.

[green]“Three installments. The roots will find you.”[/green]
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.LONG.description:
A thick root draws something from your palm. The stout mushroom's cap swells a little wider.

[green]“Past the big door. Principal and interest.”[/green]

The thin one hands you the receipt and slaps its partner's hand away from the jar.
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.GIFT.description:
The stout mushroom presses a handful of [gold]coins[/gold] into your hand.

[green]“A welcome gift!”[/green]

The thin one crosses out a line in the ledger and gives it a hard look.
events.MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.DEATH.description:
Everything goes dark.

The thin mushroom stops writing. The stout one hugs the jar tighter.
